text.description_html:
Fusion TR-G1-ORB, Rock Ridge Arched Mount Hand Towel Ring

This Sandcast Brass Arched Towel Ring is mounted to the wall and is the perfect place to hang hand towels so that they are close to the bathroom sink. It has an oil rubbed bronze finish--one of the most popular finish choices. This hand towel holder is easy to install and comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-G1 Rock Ridge Towel Bar, Fusion RH-G1 Rock Ridge Robe Hook, and Fusion PH-G1 Rock Ridge Toilet Paper Holder

Features and Specifications of the Rock Ridge Scalloped Hand Towel Ring:

  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Mount Width: 2-7/8"
  • Mount Length: 3-5/8"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
